warning_explanations.pre_black_box_flags: Each O/I pre table has 255 raw black-box flags: 249 actual synthetic/unmapped operators and six internal combinational logic_0/logic_1 cells. These are explained native operators/constants, not 255 unresolved user IP blocks. Post black-box flags and unexplained cells are zero.
warning_explanations.raw_reference_lookup_absence: Missing get_designs/get_lib_cells matches include native GEN/SEQGEN no-map cells. Actual cell attributes and the reference reports explain them. Do not publish the raw missing-reference counts as unresolved IP counts.
warning_explanations.VER-318_VER-533_VER-329: O/I have identical normalized typing-warning records: 55 signed/unsigned messages, two default-enum-width messages and one localparam-style message. Two signedness messages originate at unchanged lane lines 141 and 219; the others are in fixed packages/configuration. No new frontend width-mismatch diagnostic is reported. This is not a proof of every arithmetic width/signedness behavior.
warning_explanations.VER-1005: The support configuration function changes its by-value cfg argument and returns it. This does not drive a top-level hardware input internally.
warning_explanations.VER-104: DC ignores the unsupported unlabeled package $error. Its assertion semantics were not checked by this synthesis run.
warning_explanations.ELAB-311: An exhausted instruction CASE default at unchanged lane line 235 cannot be reached for the fixed enum. This same warning is present in every variant.
warning_explanations.LINT-1_LINT-2_pre: Pre reports retain dead intermediate combinational cells and 17 unloaded nets, including unused masku_vrgat_req fields. All 1050 sequential-cell records remain identical before/after and between O/I, so the DUT was not optimized away.
warning_explanations.LINT-28: Original unused DUT inputs alu_ready_i/mfpu_ready_i and FIFO testmode_i occur in both runs. Post adds unused native arithmetic/carry ports, for 97 warnings in each. No new external DUT port mismatch is reported.
warning_explanations.LINT-32_LINT-33: Constant controls and one source net feeding multiple input pins are reported. These are not multiple-driver diagnostics. The report has no separate multiple-driver warning.
warning_explanations.LINT-29: This category reports input-to-output feedthrough in generic arithmetic hierarchy. It does not report multiple drivers.
warning_explanations.VO-4_VO-12_VO-11: Assign/tran writer notices and generic unmapped components are expected for compile -no_map. Tables contain no tri-state cell reference. SYNOPSYS_UNCONNECTED names denote unconsumed arithmetic outputs; they do not establish undriven functional outputs. No generic-netlist/DC readback was performed, so writer readback warnings remain a real limitation.
warning_explanations.TIM-134_TIM-216_and_uncoded_endpoints: High-fanout estimation, absent external input delays, and unconstrained endpoint warnings remain with a reporting clock only. Loop checking executes without a loop warning. These reports do not establish timing closure.

limitations: Generic structural review only; no functional proof, equivalence check, technology mapping, mapped area, timing closure or physical signoff.
The count 1050 is sequential cells returned by all_registers -cells, not an independently calculated bit count.

Local snapshots contain reports, cell attributes and opaque DC WORK/SVF artifacts, but no written pre/post_generic.v or DDC. This review did not reopen a DDC or read back a netlist; VO-12 readback warnings remain recorded.
No claim that DC verified the unsupported package $error.

Source SHA compositions are checked byte for byte against command.json. Complete dependency/execution provenance remains in the existing execution records; this local review did not access the server.
Report warning absence is not formal proof against every width/signedness or multiple-driver condition outside this fixed elaboration.
